updateMessage: CineVault v3.2.4 (5.2 MB) guarantees every title shown in search plays reliably with verified HD streams and resolves actor/franchise searches automatically. Upgrading from v3.1.0 or older: uninstall the older app once first before installing.
changelog: Every search result is now pre-verified playable with automatic stream resolution and cache warm-up
Filters out unplayable stubs, broken 404 embeds, and dead trailer-only listings from Search
Isolated native Android proxy & API thread pools for zero-stutter searching and streaming
Compact 5.2 MB signed release build (same v3.2.x release key — direct update from v3.2.0–v3.2.3)
